notes: Extracted from arXiv LaTeX source (plain `tabular` inside `table*`, NOT deluxetable). Table is split across two `table*` environments (main + 'Continued.'); both parts concatenated. Row count asserted against the 94 objects stated in the abstract and conclusions. Total mass is HYDROSTATIC: derived from an isothermal beta-model fit to the Chandra X-ray surface brightness plus the single-temperature spectral fit, via the hydrostatic-equilibrium equation (paper Sect. 'mass', eq. at line 409). It is NOT an NFW fit and NOT a lensing/light-tied parametric model. M_tot carries TWO errors: statistical then systematic. Where the surface-brightness profile does not reach 5r_e the mass profiles were extrapolated to 5r_e by the authors using the slope of the last 20 points in log-log space.
